profile.about: Electrical Engineering student at WSU focused on systems engineering, communications, controls, and signal processing. Hands-on experience installing solar arrays and generators, making electrical connections, and troubleshooting power optimizers and microinverters. Built FPGA-based digital systems, real-time audio processing hardware, and GPU-accelerated fluid simulations using Unity, C#, and HLSL. Seeking Summer 2027 internships in advanced energy, controls, and engineering research.
profile.education: B.S. in Electrical Engineering — systems engineering emphasis in communications, controls, and signal processing, Washington State University, in progress.
